VIAIR EVC25 Portable Air Compressor Review

Rechargeable tire inflator for BLM roads and trailhead fixes

★★★★½4.5 / 5·~$80

Quick Verdict

We couldn't find the classic VIAIR 88P in stock — the EVC25 is a rechargeable alternative that handles slow leaks on BLM roads without needing the engine running.

Best for: Slow leaks on dirt roads, airing down for traction

Pros & Cons

✓ What we like

  • •Rechargeable — no cigarette lighter or running engine required
  • •Preset PSI with auto shut-off
  • •Handles car, truck, and SUV tires
  • •Peace of mind when you're miles from pavement

✕ Watch out for

  • •Smaller than a hardwired 88P — slower on full-size truck tires
  • •Charge it before remote trips — battery won't last forever
  • •Not a substitute for a real spare tire
